notes.title: The SS Destiny Disaster Demo 3.1 Released!
notes.content:
Demo 3.1 is here!

There has been a lot of work in the past week fixing bugs and improving things about the game. Demo 3.1 is now out, and this should be a better, polished experience with lots of fixes and some additions as well as I have added more. Here are some of the highlights:

[list]
[*]New enemy
[*]Adjusting enemy drop rates of items
[*]Changed positions of enemies to force combat
[*]Lots of bug fixes, notably a reload glitch, and glitches with the objective pop up
[*]There are 3 save slots now!
[/list]


If you play the demo and have any feedback, please use the "Feedback" button within the game itself or follow this [url=https://forms.gle/oHHz2zF9Gh1gytXz5]link to a Google Forms.[/url]

notes.title: The SS Destiny Disaster Demo 3.0 Released!
notes.content:
[h2]Demo 3.0 is here![/h2]

There has been so much work on the game in the past 2 months, and I am excited that Demo 3.0 is now out! This is a much more polished experienced with many, many, many additions. Once again, there is simply too much to list, but below are some of the big highlights!

[list]
[*]A much more balanced experienced, making the game harder and increasing the overall sense of fear
[*]Amazing new Steam art by Vitor Ximenez 
[*]Pulse rifle added
[*]Third floor of the ship has been added
[*]Popups to help guide the player along with a better tutorial experience
[*]A map to help navigate
[*]Bug fixes, so many bug fixes...
[*]New room layouts for several rooms
[*]Changes and adjustments to improve lighting
[*]Enemies ragdoll when dead!
[*]More gore/blood
[*]Big health kits added
[*]Crouching is now allowed in the future. This allows for a stealth approach to situations
[/list]

If you play the demo and have any feedback, please use the "Feedback" button within the game itself or follow [url=https://forms.gle/4HqtJ5ehUL9MwJKr5]this link to a Google Forms.[/url]

notes.title: The SS Destiny Disaster Demo 2.0 Out Now
notes.content:
After a ton of work, and I mean really a ton of work... The SS Destiny Disaster has a new and improved demo! This is Demo 2.0, and it is drastically different than the previous build. I am also beginning to add some story elements to the game. The demo's "story" will not reveal anything for the full game. 

There is really too much to list for what has been added and updated for this demo, but here's some of the main highlights:
[list]
[*]Lighting has been brightened and overall improved
[*]More/new enemy models
[*]New rooms and areas (and many others that are not a part of the demo)
[*]With these new rooms and areas, lots of details and models have been created
[*]Data is now saved
[*]Many, many, many bug fixes
[*]Code has been implemented to allow for story and scripting elements
[*]New sounds
[/list]

If you play the demo and have any feedback, please use the "Feedback" button within the game itself or follow [url=https://forms.gle/yX9C3nYZxE6dxLZ38]this link to a Google Forms.[/url] The Steam page will be updated soon with new screenshots and an updated trailer.
